simple.meaning: תָּמַם (tâmam) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to complete , in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 63 times across Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 47:15. Its contexts include land, wilderness, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תָּמַם (H8552).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: תָּמַם (tâmam) / H8552 is traced through Genesis 47:15, Genesis 47:18, Leviticus 26:20, Numbers 14:33 as a generated source-based concept entry.
